answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the signal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The relic lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the spiral is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing.
